verdict.rationale: Godot documents editor automation through EditorScripts, plugins and headless CLI runs, so asking whether it can version, review and roll back those automations is a fair question for a game engine. However, nothing in the evidence shows a built-in versioning, review or rollback capability for them. That scripts are files a user could manage in an external version-control system is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.
